canonical_policy: Reviewed media identity corrections require durable cited source evidence. Prefer explicit Wikidata P31 when accessible; where Wikidata type evidence is unavailable, an unambiguous episodic TV identity established by multiple independent title-specific sources and an existing canonical Series record may be canonicalized to Series. Never infer media type from title words or country alone.
